DETERMINATION

Northgate Advantage has completed its review of the above referenced inpatient admission. Based on the clinical information submitted, an adverse determination on the basis of medical necessity has been issued. The requested inpatient admission is not approved as medically necessary.

BASIS FOR DETERMINATION

This review was conducted using MCG-style criteria applicable to the admission under review. The documentation available at the time of admission did not meet inpatient criteria.

The following criteria were reviewed and found not met:

CHF-01: Not met. Diuresis was achieved with a single intravenous dose and could have been managed with oral medication.

CHF-02: Not met. There was no documented trial of intensified outpatient therapy before admission.

No other criteria codes were applied to this determination.

CLAIM ADJUSTMENT INFORMATION

The following codes apply to the associated claim:
CARC CO-50
RARC N115

APPEAL RIGHTS AND INSTRUCTIONS

A request for reconsideration of this adverse determination on the basis of medical necessity may be submitted within the applicable filing window. Any clinical rationale submitted in support of reconsideration must map each finding stated above to the corresponding numbered criterion. Submissions that do not address the numbered criteria individually may be returned without substantive review.

Level of care denials are not eligible for provider appeal.

Appeals must be received by [[APPEAL_DEADLINE]]. Requests received after that point will not be accepted for reconsideration under this claim number.

All correspondence must reference Member ID MBR314786663 and Claim Number CLM38739855773, and must include the dates of service [[ADMIT_DATE]] through [[DISCHARGE_DATE]].

This notice reflects a coverage determination based on the criteria identified above and does not constitute medical advice or direction regarding treatment. Treatment decisions remain the responsibility of the member and the treating practitioner.

The criteria used in this review are available upon written request.
